description: MainActivity class for the Tic-Tac-Toe app, handling UI rendering, user interactions, and game state updates.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing the Tic-Tac-Toe game UI, user interactions, and updating game state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and wiring click listeners.

methods.name: wireCellClicks
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to each game cell button.

methods.name: onCellClicked
methods.description: Handles a cell click, updates game state if move is legal, and triggers UI re-render.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state and UI to start a new game.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates UI reflecting current game state, player turns, and game end conditions.
